# Claude Code Security Reviewer

> {BLOCKQUOTE}

{DESCRIPTION}

---

## Source Modules

### claudecode.claude_api_client

*Source: claudecode/claude_api_client.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-security-review/blob/main/claudecode/claude_api_client.py*

- `ClaudeAPIClient`: Client for calling Claude API directly for security analysis tasks.
- `validate_api_access`: Validate that API access is working.
- `call_with_retry`: Make Claude API call with retry logic.
- `analyze_single_finding`: Analyze a single security finding to filter false positives using Claude API.
- `get_claude_api_client`: Convenience function to get Claude API client.

### claudecode.evals.eval_engine

*Source: claudecode/evals/eval_engine.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-security-review/blob/main/claudecode/evals/eval_engine.py*

- `EvalCase`: Single evaluation test case.
- `EvalResult`: Result of a single evaluation.
- `to_dict`: Convert to dictionary for JSON serialization.
- `EvaluationEngine`: Engine for running security evaluations on GitHub PRs.
- `log`: Log a message if verbose mode is enabled.
- `run_evaluation`: Run security evaluation on a single PR.
- `run_single_evaluation`: Convenience function to run a single evaluation.

### claudecode.evals.run_eval

*Source: claudecode/evals/run_eval.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-security-review/blob/main/claudecode/evals/run_eval.py*

- `EvalCase`: Single evaluation test case.
- `EvalResult`: Result of a single evaluation.
- `to_dict`: Convert to dictionary for JSON serialization.
- `main`: Main entry point for single PR SAST evaluation.

### claudecode.findings_filter

*Source: claudecode/findings_filter.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-security-review/blob/main/claudecode/findings_filter.py*

- `FilterStats`: Statistics about the filtering process.
- `HardExclusionRules`: Hard exclusion rules for common false positives.
- `get_exclusion_reason`: Check if a finding should be excluded based on hard rules.
- `FindingsFilter`: Main filter class for security findings.
- `filter_findings`: Filter security findings to remove false positives.

### claudecode.github_action_audit

*Source: claudecode/github_action_audit.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-security-review/blob/main/claudecode/github_action_audit.py*

- `ConfigurationError`: Raised when configuration is invalid or missing.
- `AuditError`: Raised when security audit operations fail.
- `GitHubActionClient`: Simplified GitHub API client for GitHub Actions environment.
- `get_pr_data`: Get PR metadata and files from GitHub API.
- `get_pr_diff`: Get complete PR diff in unified format.
- `SimpleClaudeRunner`: Simplified Claude Code runner for GitHub Actions.
- `run_security_audit`: Run Claude Code security audit.
- `validate_claude_available`: Validate that Claude Code is available.
- `get_environment_config`: Get and validate environment configuration.
- `initialize_clients`: Initialize GitHub and Claude clients.
- `initialize_findings_filter`: Initialize findings filter based on environment configuration.
- `run_security_audit`: Run the security audit with Claude Code.
- `apply_findings_filter`: Apply findings filter to reduce false positives.
- `main`: Main execution function for GitHub Action.

### claudecode.json_parser

*Source: claudecode/json_parser.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-security-review/blob/main/claudecode/json_parser.py*

- `extract_json_from_text`: Extract JSON object from text, looking in various formats and locations.
- `parse_json_with_fallbacks`: Parse JSON from text with multiple fallback strategies and error handling.

### claudecode.logger

*Source: claudecode/logger.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-security-review/blob/main/claudecode/logger.py*

- `get_logger`: Get a configured logger that outputs to stderr.

### claudecode.prompts

*Source: claudecode/prompts.py | URL: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-security-review/blob/main/claudecode/prompts.py*

- `get_security_audit_prompt`: Generate security audit prompt for Claude Code.
